description: 公民營廢棄物甲級處理機構許可資料 [waste management] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 環境部資源循環署. 提供各項甲級處理機構許可資料，包括機構基本資料、每月許可處理量、廢棄物種類及處理方法。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 環境部資源循環署. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
